stem.text: When $0.010\,\text{mol}$ of a hydrocarbon X reacts with $720\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of hydrogen at room conditions, an alkane is formed.

A.alt: Skeletal formula: two six-membered rings joined by a single bond, each ring containing a C=C, each carrying one methyl group and one isopropenyl group.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: a cyclohexane ring with a methyl group and an isopropylidene group (=C(CH3)2), linked by CH2 to a chain CH2-C(CH3)=CH-C(CH3)=CH-C(CH3)=CH2.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: a cyclohexene ring with a methyl on its C=C, joined by an exocyclic C=C bearing a methyl to a chain ending in CH=C(CH3)2.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: a bicyclic (decalin-type) system with a C=C in each ring, a methyl group on each ring and an isopropyl group at the bottom.
